name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Rotating Keychain
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering durability, clarity, and a smooth finish.
    - Features a 3-layer acrylic and 2-part structure:
                                 (P1) Display Frame (Part 1): 3 layers.
                                             →  Layer 1 & Layer 3: Acrylic 2mm.
                                             →  Layer 2 (middle): Acrylic 5mm for added depth and stability.
                                 (P2) Inner  360° Rotating Board (Part 2): 1-layer acrylic, 2mm thick.
    - Smooth, polished edges ensure comfortable daily use.
    - Includes a sturdy metal keyring for secure attachment to keys or bags.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 3 x 3 inches ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm.
    - Length of metal keyring: approx. 1.97 inches ~ 5 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing on the inner rotating board, with single-sided printing on selected display frame layers for a clean and polished look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a rotating acrylic keychain with an inner spinning board for an interactive effect.
    - Allows viewing the design from multiple angles as the inner piece rotates freely.
    - Perfect for use on keys, backpacks, handbags, or as a decorative accessory.
    - Functions as both a personalized keepsake and a stylish everyday key accessory.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful and personalized gift for dads, moms, partners, friends, and family members.
    - Ideal for Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, and more.
    - A unique keepsake that combines personalization with a fun rotating design. 
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Rotating Keychain

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
